content_sections.heading: RPCAU Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. Advt. No. 06/RPCAU/Temp./2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download RPCAU notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: M.Sc. in any discipline of Agricultural Science (Agricultural Extension/Economics/Statistics/Soil Science/Agronomy/Breeding/Entomology/Pathology/Horticulture) with 4/5 years of Bachelor's degree; OR post-graduate degree in Basic Science with 3 years Bachelor's degree and 2 years Master's degree with NET qualification and 2 years of Research Experience Experience: Experience in field surveys, conducting trials/demonstration, data collection, conducting training, developing technical literature, data analysis, report writing, etc., and proficiency in computer and Data Management will be preferred. Age limit: Minimum shall be 21 years and maximum Age shall be 45 years (as on closing date) Other conditions: Positions are purely temporary and contractual in nature and co-terminus with the project. Desirable: Experience in field surveys, conducting trials/demonstration, data collection, conducting training, developing technical literature, data analysis, report writing Proficiency in computer and Data Management

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initially offered till 31st March, 2027 or till termination of the project or unavailability of funds whichever is earlier. Extendable based on periodic review and satisfactory performance.

content_sections.heading: How Will RPCAU Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting based on academic qualification, experience, publication, achievements/awards etc. Walk-in-interview Shortlisting on the basis of academic qualification, experience, publication, achievements/awards etc. Walk-in-interview process

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form Original and self-attested copies of date of birth proof Educational qualification certificates Experience certificates 05 copies of updated duly signed short CV (not more than 02 pages) No Objection Certificate if employed elsewhere

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RPCAU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Attend the walk-in-interview on 31/10/2026 at 09:00 AM. Report positively before half an hour to the prescribed time. Bring print out of application form duly filled in the prescribed proforma along with original and self-attested copies of all necessary documents. Bring 05 copies of updated duly signed short CV (not more than 02 pages).

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: List of qualified candidates will be released on the day of walk-in-interview. If interview is not conducted as scheduled due to unavoidable circumstances, candidates may have to stay for the next day without TA/DA.
